responsibility: Implements the x86 backend’s file-end emission hook for Intel CET metadata on ELF/Linux targets. This source file augments the normal executable-stack note handling by examining `flag_cf_protection` and, when indirect-branch tracking and/or shadow-stack protection are enabled, writing the `.note.gnu.property` entry that encodes the GNU x86 feature bits for IBT and SHSTK into the assembler output; in other words, it owns the generated object-note side of CET support rather than the user intrinsics or generic backend instruction patterns.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem header gcc/config/i386/cet.h, this .c file is the compiler backend implementation that emits CET GNU property notes at file end based on GCC’s internal flag_cf_protection state and exec-stack handling. The header instead provides assembler-facing macros and inline assembly directives such as _CET_ENDBR and note emission for assembly sources under __ASSEMBLER__.
